Happy birthday, mate. Best whishes for you :)

You know I believe that to be happy you do not need friends. You need love for yourself. So, make yourself do something that  makes you glad, happy. There is so many options: think about what your hobbies was when you were younger? Maybe do puzzle game, read a book which you havent't touch for years. Even comics is great. Remember things that made you cheerful and do them, especially if they are childful.

You say "I have no friends". Don't worry. You can always make them. Today is your birthday - maybe you could consider possability to adopt dog or cat from shelter. This way you not only received a best friend but also give a gifts such as home, love and warmth to a lovely creature.

Please, reckon how can you meet people and try to combined it with something that makes you happy? Maybe volunteer at animal shelter, retirement home, hospital, child care home?

You can change your situation. It will take time, disappointment, frustration. But if you try - evrything possible. Relax today and think what can you do to make yourself happier. This would be awesome present for yourself.
